text: ポケモンは　こうやって　どんどん　たたかわせて　つよく　してかないと！

structure.jp: こうやって　どんどん　たたかわせて
structure.en: making them battle like this, more and more

structure.jp: つよく　してかないと！
structure.en: you have to keep making them stronger!

patterns.name: 〜ないと
patterns.explanation: A 'not' verb plus と means 'if you don't...', with the bad result left unsaid, so it means 'you have to'. つよく　してかないと = 'you have to keep making them stronger'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: The せる ending turns a verb into 'make someone do it'. たたかわせて = 'making them battle'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: ていく after a verb says you keep doing it from now on; here していかない is squeezed to してかない in casual speech. つよく　してかない = 'not go on making them stronger'.
